title: Charters Serialization Format
description: JSON Schema for the canonical serialization of charter documents (see charters.md). Describes charter facts only: Actions and Plans have their own projections and join back through their charter reference, so they are never embedded here. Field names follow the charter frontmatter; each description names the v4 actions ontology property it projects.

charters.description: Flat array of charters. Hierarchy is carried by each charter's parent reference, not by nesting.

id.description: Frontmatter `id`. UUIDv7 preferred. Omitted when the document declares none: an ephemeral identity is never serialized (see Concept Identity in workspace.md).

state.description: hasCharterState — frontmatter `state`. Locally asserted lifecycle state; an omitted source state projects as `new`. Inherited engagement eligibility is derived and not serialized here.

title.description: rdfs:label — frontmatter `title`, or the document's first heading.

description.description: Content under the title heading, including its subsections.

alias.description: hasAlias — a short human handle, scoped within the parent charter.

parent.description: Inverse of hasSubCharter — reference (alias or UUID, never title) to the parent charter, whether declared in frontmatter or derived from directory placement. Absent for a root charter.

objectives.description: inServiceOf — frontmatter `objectives`: references to the Objectives this charter serves.

defaults.description: Frontmatter `defaults`: key-value settings applied to descendants. Keys are not yet specified.

log.description: Entries of the `Log` section, in document order (which is time order: entries are appended).

sections.description: Sibling sections after the core section (excluding `Log`), in document order.

heading.description: Heading text without the leading `#` markers.

body.description: Content under the heading, including its subsections.

at.description: The entry's leading ISO 8601 date or date-time. Omitted for an undated entry; never filled in after the fact.

text.description: Entry text after the date and separator.
